maddeler.e:
نتناس (form VI)
# نَتَنَاسَ (natanāsa) /na.ta.naː.sa/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاسَى (tanāsā)
# نُتَنَاسَ (nutanāsa) /nu.ta.naː.sa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of تَنَاسَى (tanāsā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
